source.description: 153,075 player records across 17 PC databases. At most 10,000 per title; all records retained in smaller years. Prepared November 12, 2026.
source.note: Squad players ("Assigned to team") of each title: per nationality the first 36 outfielders and 4 goalkeepers in the workbook's order (its own ranking: the stored overall for FIFA 09-14, a position-weighted estimate before). Values are the workbook's, unchanged (a date of birth stored as an Excel day number is written as ISO text).
